## Download

| File | What it is |
|---|---|
| **`LumiDisplay.exe`** | The app. Download and double-click — no installer, no .NET required. |
| `LumiDisplay-win-x64.zip` | Same app, zipped with the README and license. |

**Requirements:** Windows 10 (1809+) or Windows 11, 64-bit. External monitors need **DDC/CI enabled** in their on-screen menu.

## Install

1. Download **`LumiDisplay.exe`** and put it somewhere permanent, e.g. `C:\Users\<you>\Apps\LumiDisplay\`.
2. Double-click it. If Windows SmartScreen says *"Windows protected your PC"*, click **More info → Run anyway** (the app is not code-signed).
3. The settings window opens. Turn on **Start with Windows** if you want it running after every sign-in.

Closing the window keeps LumiDisplay running in the system tray. Use **Quit LumiDisplay** to stop it.
